intent.primary_message: The product is the clearest proof of the offer

concept.visual_proposition: Place one exact product as the dominant hero in a quiet field with one evidence-bearing environmental interaction
concept.visual_proof: The environment reacts to the product while the pack remains unobstructed and immediately recognizable

composition.hero: large product occupying the dominant visual mass without touching the text field
composition.negative_space: quiet field reserved for copy and breathing room
composition.crop_logic: preserve complete product silhouette and label
composition.typography_zone: clear field separated from the product silhouette

typography.alignment: aligned to the primary text anchor
typography.line_break_logic: break by meaning, not by arbitrary box width

color.value_structure: hero and primary text remain distinct from the background in grayscale
color.contrast_target: verify final text contrast when rendered digitally

lighting.shadow_behavior: grounded contact and coherent cast shadow

restraints: no decorative effects without a communication, hierarchy, depth, material, or brand job
